exact_statement: For every disjoint Boolean substitution F=h(g_1,...,g_k) on independent uniform physical blocks and coordinate i in child j, write h=A+y_j B in the current other-output normalized product basis, m=E g_j, v=1-m^2, beta=g_jhat({i}), t=beta^2, C_T=a_T+m b_T, q=sum b_T^2. With e(s,t)=phi(s)+phi(t)-phi(s+t), d(a,b)=phi(a^2)+phi(b^2)-(phi((a+b)^2)+phi((a-b)^2))/2, phi(s)=s log2(1/s), M(t)=sum e(C_T^2,t b_T^2), N(t)=sum[d(C_T,beta b_T)-e(C_T^2,t b_T^2)], B_i(F)=q[B_i(g_j)-e(m^2,t)]+M(t) and D_i(F)=q[D_i(g_j)-d(m,beta)]+M(t)+N(t). For v>0, 0<=t<=v, M(t)<=min{M(v),(t/v)M(v)+q t log2(v/t)}, M(v)=B_j^mu(h), and 0<=N(t)<=(2/ln2)qt. The log and N terms cost at most [(2+2/e)/ln2] times consumed physical query influence in any represented stopping tree. Constants are absorbed at v=0. The corrected residual M(t)-q e(m^2,t) may be negative; AND2(OR2,OR2) gives 1/4-(9/8)log2(3)+(5/8)log2(5)<0.
